Item.Name: DHQ_DON_TYPES
Item.Hint: Enter similar questionnaire Donation Types. Separate with comma ',' if multiple or select from LISTVAL.

Trigger.Name: KEY-LISTVAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_temp VARCHAR2(400);
 v_len NUMBER;
 v_lov BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 v_temp:=:ABBR_ELIG_CRITERIA.DHQ_DON_TYPES||',';
 v_lov:=SHOW_LOV('lov_don_types');
 
 IF v_lov THEN
 :ABBR_ELIG_CRITERIA.DHQ_DON_TYPES:=v_temp||:ABBR_ELIG_CRITERIA.DHQ_DON_TYPES;
 IF substr(:ABBR_ELIG_CRITERIA.DHQ_DON_TYPES,1,1)=',' THEN
 v_len:=NVL(LENGTH(:ABBR_ELIG_CRITERIA.DHQ_DON_TYPES), 0);
 :ABBR_ELIG_CRITERIA.DHQ_DON_TYPES:=SUBSTR(:ABBR_ELIG_CRITERIA.DHQ_DON_TYPES,2,v_len-1);
 END IF;
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(:banner.hdr_date) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(:banner.hdr_date) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

SELECT inter_code, inter_desc
 FROM valid_interdictions
 WHERE inter_type = 'INTER'
 AND SYSDATE between eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+1)
ORDER BY inter_code

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DON_TYPES
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT donation_type, description
 FROM valid_donation_types
 WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+1)
 AND donation_type != '99'
ORDER BY sort_sequence
